name: cheapearth9's apps
subtitle: Every iOS app I build on GitHub
description: Sideloadable iOS apps built on GitHub by cheapearth9. They are unsigned: AltStore / SideStore sign them with your own Apple ID. Any repo of mine with an ios-latest release that contains an .ipa shows up here by itself.

cheapearth9/vacuumtube-forked-by-claude.name: VacuumTube
cheapearth9/vacuumtube-forked-by-claude.subtitle: YouTube TV, no ads
cheapearth9/vacuumtube-forked-by-claude.description: An unofficial iOS port of VacuumTube: the regular YouTube TV interface with an ad blocker and VacuumTube's settings menu. Plug in an HDMI adapter or use AirPlay and YouTube appears on that screen; the iPad or iPhone becomes the remote. External keyboards work too.

cheapearth9/AirBrowser.subtitle: Browser for your HDMI / AirPlay screen
cheapearth9/AirBrowser.description: A browser that can put pages on a connected HDMI or AirPlay display while the iPad or iPhone stays the controller.
